name: Felothar the Steadfast
oracle_text:
Each creature you control assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
Creatures you control can attack as though they didn't have defender.
{3}, {T}, Sacrifice another creature: Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's toughness, then discard cards equal to its power.
blocked_sentences: Each creature you control assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
Creatures you control can attack as though they didn't have defender.

needs.what: a static (Doran, the Siege Tower style) whose `affects` filter selects creatures that assign combat damage equal to their toughness rather than their power (rule 510.1a substitution in the combat damage step), here affects: {controller: you, types: [Creature]}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No static in static_effects touches combat damage assignment; buff/set_pt change real power, which would also change power reads elsewhere (and the card's own activated ability reads power separately), and replace_damage only scales or adds to an amount, it cannot swap the source stat

needs.what: a static whose `affects` filter selects creatures that can attack as though they didn't have defender (they keep the keyword), here affects: {controller: you, types: [Creature]}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: lose_keyword removes defender entirely, which is a different card (the creatures would no longer have defender for any other purpose, e.g. cards that count or reference defender); cant_attack and attacks_if_able are restrictions/requirements, not an override of the defender restriction
